Frontend mapper activation is gated by registered immutable page metadata or semantic main-menu, campaign-setup, prebattle, or Battle Results ownership.
All 50 known frontend page families are classified from their exact metadata-row spans, so shared mode values such as LAN mode 6 cannot disarm a live frontend.
Registered frontend ownership is polled by live render-root identity across focus changes while stale roots remain unable to rearm gameplay.
New Campaign setup is recognized from its complete immutable page-metadata graph, not from shared mode or 800x600 geometry.
An active setup mapper is preserved across focus changes, but verified loading disarm cannot be rearmed by stale setup state.
Quick Battle 3D rendering and its results page are separated by exact frontend page identity.
Prebattle ownership begins before its resource graph is built and ends with the modal battle-resolution lifecycle.
Shared 800x600 surface geometry never rearms stale frontend state.
Loading capture synchronizes semantic gameplay ownership before preserving a plane.
Successful primary-staging locks notify dgVoodoo through its guarded-page lifecycle before gameplay updates the surface.
The notification is gated by exact live surface identity rather than 800x600 geometry and preserves the origin pixel byte exactly.
dgVoodoo fake fullscreen keeps the scaled swapchain in the application window across resolution, focus, and RDP transitions.
Frontend-to-loading transitions keep the game and dgVoodoo presentation window on the active monitor instead of exposing logical-mode window sizes.
Strategy and battle selectors preserve their existing ordered mode records while excluding dimensions above the active presentation monitor's preferred physical mode.
Saved selections that no longer fit fall back independently to the highest remaining existing strategy or battle mode.
Presentation input mapping is restricted to a verified live decorated non-fullscreen HWND; fake fullscreen passes dgVoodoo's logical coordinates through unchanged so they are transformed exactly once.
Decorated-window cursor reads, warps, and mouse messages use the same checked aspect-fit mapping, including letterboxing and DPI-scaled desktop coordinates, while fullscreen, stale, replaced-HWND, minimized, or invalid state fails open without changing the game's input.
Immediately before a decorated-window Alt+Enter transition, an out-of-client OS cursor is restored to its last valid logical game position (or the live content center when no history exists), preventing origin-driven camera corruption without changing ordinary mouse or keyboard input.
Frontend-to-loading shrink suppression is restricted to a verified borderless popup, while exact monitor-sized decorated expansion remains rejected.
For an explicit non-fullscreen dgVoodoo presentation, successful wrapper sizing establishes live window ownership; subsequent game logical-mode moves and smaller backend frame adjustments cannot expose transient internal dimensions while fullscreen, user-resized, stale, or unknown geometry remains fail-open.
Fully off-clip prebattle unit icons are rejected before the game's RLE sprite row decoder; ordinary and partly visible icons continue through the original decoder.
Campaign keyboard/action and edge camera inputs receive independent elapsed-time displacement at the verified game call sites, preserving their combined 60 Hz travel without limiting frame rate.
